Servo Spools

  1. Screw cable spool (6) into aluminum servo mount (43) with three screws (45). Loctite on threads.
  2. Attach mount to servo with large screw (44) and Loctite.
  3. Thread a cable into the servo spool.
  4. Mark the length for that servo number (table →).
  5. Repeat for servos 1–6.

Marked length

Measured from where the cord leaves the spool. Cords are 300 mm from knot.
